description: Compares your own probability estimate for an event against a prediction market's price (manual entry, or a live Kalshi ticker, Limitless slug, or Myriad slug) and sizes a bet using fractional Kelly criterion bet sizing (default: quarter-Kelly, a standard conservative haircut on full Kelly, stated explicitly as a convention). Returns a zero Kelly stake whenever your probability doesn't exceed the market's price: no edge. Use when user asks "does this bet have edge?" or "what does Kelly sizing give for my probability estimate against the market's price?". Provide exactly one of marketProbabilityPct/kalshiTicker/limitlessSlug/myriadSlug. Returns: edgePct, evPerDollarStaked, fullKellyFraction, cappedKellyFraction, recommendedStakeUsd, verdict (a label for the size of cappedKellyFraction: skip_this_one/think_twice/worth_the_risk/take_it, not a recommendation). If available is false, do not use any result field (computed figures and any verdict are null or empty), so read available first.

bankrollUsd.description: Bankroll available for this bet, in USD

kalshiTicker.description: A Kalshi market ticker to fetch the market probability from live instead of supplying it manually.

kellyFractionCap.description: Fraction of full Kelly to actually stake, 0.01-1. Default 0.25 (quarter-Kelly).

limitlessSlug.description: A Limitless Exchange market slug to fetch the market probability from live instead of supplying it manually.

marketProbabilityPct.description: The market's probability (price), 0.01-99.99. Use this OR one of the live sources below, not both.

myriadSlug.description: A Myriad Markets market slug to fetch the market probability from live instead of supplying it manually. Not every market has a Yes/No outcome.

name: workflow.run_prediction_market_edge
title: Prediction Market Edge
